verdict.rationale: AngelList documents an admin toggle to 'Allow exercises through the AngelList platform' and linking a bank account to the equity plan, which implies online exercise with electronic payment collection. The evidence does not describe the employee-side exercise flow or show that exercising automatically issues shares; the auto-generated share security in the docs belongs to transfers, not exercises. Missing for 10: documented employee-facing exercise workflow, explicit payment flow details, automatic share issuance upon exercise, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an employee, I can exercise my vested options online — including payment and the resulting share issuance — without paper forms

citations.quote: Toggle on Allow exercises through the AngelList platform and Save.
Navigate to your equity plan and click Actions > Managed linked bank accounts. Click Link an account to link a bank account
